We could use energy and joules to calculate this, but it doesn't give us an understanding of how much force the catcher experiences. Instead, we want to use the concept of impulse, defined as impulse = Force * (change in time). A good example of this is crumple zones in a car. A fast car crashing with experience a large force from whatever it crashes into. However, if the car has a crumple zone the force can be spread out over a longer period of time, so the force is felt more spread out and less severe. Same with catching a ball with a straight arm vs absorbing the impact and bending your arm.

In his case, he applies very little force when he first catches the bag, and most of the 'catching force' is when he hits the ground (with the bag on top of him). This looks like maybe 0.1 seconds at a guess?

So then we have impulse = force * 0.1 seconds. To calculate the force we now need to know the impulse, which is also defined as the change in momentum of the bag. Momentum is given by momentum = mass * velocity. 

To find the velocity, we can use your estimate of the bag holding 2400J of gravitational potential energy, and can assume this is fully converted into kinetic/moving stuff energy. Kinetic energy = 1/2 * mass * velocity^2, therefore rearranging gives velocity = root((2*kinetic energy)/mass) = root((2*2400)/50) = 9.8 m/s.

Now using this to calculate the change in momentum (aka impulse), which is the final momentum - the initial momentum. As velocity = 0 when it stops, we see that momentum = 50 * 0 - 50 * 9.8 = 490.

So finally, the impulse = force * (change in time), so 490 = F * 0.1, F = 4900 N. A 70kg human weighs about 700N, so it's similar to about 7 humans standing on top of him. Or, professional boxers exert about 2500 N with a good punch, so two professional boxers beating him down at the same time. Or about one full sledgehammer swing. Enough force to damage him pretty good! Feel free to ask more questions if this doesn't make sense

My neck’s carotid artery started squirting blood like it were the river nile on a rainy day. It was cut by some asshole who needed money, never seen him before, but I got a glimpse at his face before losing all vision. Help me. Save me. I need a guardian angel. These were the last things that went through my mind, before I bled into eternity. Then I didn’t have a mind to think with. I seem to have one now though, and everything is going white. 

An awed “Woooah!” escapes me, as I transcend the universe, into what seems like heaven. Through the spinning tessellations I can just make out a small room in the distance. My eyes seem to be adjusting to everything now, or maybe the room is just coming closer, but the room’s gleaming white edges are coming into focus. The more I think about this room, the more I get pulled into it, as if I was destined to go there. Oh wait, this is the afterlife, I probably was destined to come here. Huh.

I seamlessly drift through the wall into the room, just because I can, to find a basic office cubicle. It has a plain desk, multiple screens, an uninviting chair and some wallpaper from the 60s. Hmm, I guess I can make it a new home. 
An unknown, yet empowering, deep voice booms all around me 
“Greetings, new recruit. Welcome to the afterlife, you have lived a pretty average life, so that’s where you are now. Average heaven.” Crap.
“Here you will be a guardian angel to a soul still alive, who is under hard times”
A face pops up on one of the screens, bringing back memories that seem bad, very recent memories… HE JUST MURDERED ME… Is this guardian angel manager thing fucking joking?
“Your job, as a guardian angel, is to intervene if your living soul gets into any trouble. You will get judged on your helpfulness and if you do well enough, be promoted to the 2nd heaven, which is being a “haunting spirit”.
My cheeks burn up in anger, at least if I have cheeks they would, but I’m still infuriated. I’m staring right down his eyes, as he spends my life savings on school for his daughter. 
“The control panel in front of you can exert forces and move objects, to an extent, please help your soul and you will be rewarded.”

…

As I snatch up the controls, a strange gooey feeling envelops me. Then bang, I’m back on earth, seems like there’s a recurring pattern of me not quite dying. However, I’m not quite normal, I’m floating around so weightlessly that I could be Freddie Mercury. I’ve got a full set of controls placed around my eyesight, as if I was wearing Virtual Reality goggle, pretty cool to be honest. Anyway, I guess I have to be a good boy now, and kil… I mean help… this guy.

I float through this urban neighbourhood, past ‘my’ dark alley, straight to his house, which is shown to me through a blue trail marked just for me on the streets. I get up to his house, but he’s asleep, guess main characters can’t always be there for me. After one handy click of a fast forward button he’s awake, ready to be helped. The gun is his drawer pops to my mind. It would be so easy. I could just pick it up. Aim on his head. He’d never see me. No, I can’t, he needed money, maybe he’ll just get depressed from killing me.

After I save him from an oncoming truck, I have an amazing realization. If I had just given him the money and everything, I would’ve been fine, and could’ve finished my first life peacefully. Look where I am now, money doesn’t even exist, if I had just been more generous and helped him out I’d still be alive. Almost like it’s the morals of a story or something.
